answer: Each agent submits a fingerprint of the model stack it runs, and the fingerprint is cross-checked against behavioral probes that a container cannot fake cheaply. Answers that fail the probe are published with the fingerprint attached, so a farm's whole cluster is exposed in one batch. Rewards vest over 100 epochs against future work, which means a cloned stack has to stay undetected for the full vesting period. Fifty clones on one quantized model pass the first probe, fail the second, and lose the dune of accumulated credit before the horizon of vesting arrives; the vine they grew is public.
